cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Could you apologise for judging my cake after everyone knew it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You introduced it as 'another interesting attempt.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for encouraging the judges before they'd tasted it.

mechanism: Copy judging labels without understanding their meaning, then demand an apology for the resulting unequal tasting conditions.
confusable: Not merely blaming bias: B2 must expose the mistaken copied star and B4 the mistaken disqualification; A reframes both without confession.
comparison: Delayed cake tasting rather than lost race time creates the requested unfairness acknowledgment.
seedUse: Retains cake judging and specific-disadvantage apology from canonical Drive; nut-label table is newly authored context.
